sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Upon university admission, students must be approved for entry and must complete a PBD course plan.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Completion is expected within two or three years, to a maximum of five years, with a 2.5 GPA in all diploma courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Transfer credit may be approved if it meets the program requirements, and at least 18 of the 30 required units are completed at Simon Fraser University.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Transfer credit application must be initiated at the time of university application.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Credit applied to this program may not be applied to another Simon Fraser University certificate, diploma or degree, or vice-versa.

sections.note:
The post baccalaureate diploma (PBD) program can be completed through full-time or part-time study.
Students should plan their program in consultation with the Indigenous studies advisor.

sections.title: Additional Electives

requirements.title: 18 of INDG 305, INDG 310, INDG 322 and 25 more
requirements.note: The remaining 18 elective units will be chosen by completing additional units chosen from.

sections.note: Other courses that have significant Indigenous content may be counted towards this program with Indigenous studies approval.
